title: Who Did It, and What Will Happen
label: ch:ur-who-did-it-and-what-will-happen
canDo: I can say who did something, with ne and a verb that follows the thing (us ne roṭī khāī), and what will happen, for every person (karūṅ gā, kare gā, kareṅ ge).
